answer: Each identity locks a 90-credit bond and splits a quartz tally: half kept, half on a public board. Each epoch the lantern calls a random tenth to show the kept half in one hour; mismatches burn the bond. A rented half fails the match and sends a ripple across the board, flagging all sharing one lender. At 55 credits a split, 1,000 fakes burn 55,000 for a 40,000 pool: a net loss of 15,000. An honest agent splits once, pays 55, and keeps the bond.
